Predictive typing engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume keyboard-friendly text entry in the binary covers storefront language. iOS, iPadOS, and Connect actually separate prediction playback from product-page copy:

  • Predictive Text & system suggestion bar — Apple's next-word chips and prediction row above the system keyboard key row. Controls what buyers see when they type on device. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • QuickPath & swipe-to-type gestures — Apple's swipe typing path on the system keyboard where users glide finger-to-letter without lifting. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains QuickPath value to buyers.
  • UITextInput, autocorrect & custom prediction — engineering work for text fields, custom suggestion UI, or in-app typing models. Listing copy should match what your gallery shows — a prediction-bar demo is not a Passwords AutoFill sheet unless that is what the screenshot depicts.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Predictive Text support in the app.

Working text-entry flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. Predictive Text-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Predictive Text marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe keyboard prediction workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Predictive Text vs 预测文本 vs 预测输入

US pages use "Predictive Text", "Next-word suggestions", or "Keyboard predictions." China storefront copy often uses 预测文本 when referencing Apple's feature name, 预测输入 when describing predictive typing behavior, or 键盘预测 when pointing to keyboard-level suggestions — depending on whether you mean the system toggle, the suggestion bar, or typing speed benefits. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual scope.

QuickPath vs 快速路径 vs swipe-to-type

Screenshot galleries may show QuickPath swipe trails (快速路径, 滑动输入) on the system keyboard. Match caption vocabulary to whether you mean Apple's QuickPath specifically or generic swipe typing on a third-party keyboard — different buyer intent from custom keyboard extension marketing.

Next-word suggestions vs 输入建议

Prediction-bar marketing often pairs with tap-to-complete chips above the key row (输入建议, 词语建议). zh-Hans copy should name suggestion workflows only when your English listing and screenshots already claim them — not imply universal prediction coverage when your gallery shows one text field only.

Settings → Keyboard → Predictive vs in-app typing preferences

Some apps badge system keyboard settings walkthroughs; others lead with in-app autocorrect or custom suggestion panels. Listing copy should distinguish Settings → 键盘 → 预测 system-setting language from in-app typing preference panels unless your English page already makes that scope clear.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need predictive-typing search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 预测文本, 预测输入, 键盘预测, 输入建议, and 快速路径 each signal different intent from Autofill, Dictation, or custom keyboard keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Predictive Text" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Promotional text refreshes

Typing feature launches and new QuickPath or prediction updates often land in the 170-character promotional text field above the description — updatable without a new binary.
